_about: Camera profile spec for simulating smartphone capture of a 1-inch pick-glass window (WVAQ 2027). Written 2026-10-07 by the camera_aug research job. Justification and citations: camera_aug/RESEARCH.md section 6. Values marked 'assumption' have no direct published source and should be checked against real phones before they are claimed in the paper.
share_weight_note: share_weight = suggested sampling probability of each profile (sums to 1); market-informed (IDC 2025 price segments), skewed to budget phones for shop-floor staff (assumption), with legacy_16mp_2019 kept at 0.15 so the simulator also covers the capture conditions of our own data.

units.ppi: output pixels per inch of fabric inside the rectified pick-glass window (= window side length in px, since the window is 1 inch)
units.u: milli-inch (1/1000 inch) of fabric, the unit used by methods/degrade.py; 1 u = 25.4 um
units.sigma_px: Gaussian sigma in OUTPUT pixels of the full photo (before rectification)
units.lambda_shot, lambda_read: Brooks et al. 2019 heteroscedastic Gaussian model on linear raw in [0,1]: var = lambda_read + lambda_shot * x

window_fraction_of_long_side.model: 0.734 * f_eq_mm / f_loupe_mm  (afocal relay: magnifier focal length f_loupe, phone main camera 35mm-equivalent focal length f_eq, 4:3 sensor)

digital_zoom.note: assumption: users may pinch-zoom so the window fills more of the screen; above ~1.6-1.8x the 1-inch window no longer fits the 4:3 short side. On binned 12.5 MP outputs zoom is crop+upsample (no new detail); on 48-200 MP sensors up to 2x can be an in-sensor crop with real detail.

global.thread_pitch_check: pixels per thread = ppi / TPI; flag samples with < 2.5 px per thread on the finer axis (near Nyquist; label observability not guaranteed)

optics_loupe.defocus_sigma_u_per_mm: sigma_u = (D_cam / f_loupe) * delta_mm / 4 / 0.0254, with D_cam = f_cam / N (camera entrance pupil). Budget 1/2.76in f/1.8: 0.38-0.45 u per mm; 1/1.56in f/1.6-1.8: 0.62-0.90 u per mm
optics_loupe.field_curvature_singlet: Petzval sag s = h^2 / (2 n f_loupe), n ~ 1.5: 1.1-1.3 mm at the window edge midpoints (h = 12.7 mm), 2.2-2.6 mm at the corners (h = 18 mm); with AF on the centre this gives the corner sigma listed per profile
optics_loupe.rotation_lever: a phone tilt of 0.1 deg moves the fabric-plane view by f_loupe * 0.0017 rad = 2.9-3.4 u, so motion blur is set by angular shake times f_loupe

examples: Samsung Galaxy A07 4G (50 MP ISOCELL JN1, 1/2.76in, 0.64 um, f/1.8, PDAF, no OIS)
Samsung Galaxy A17 5G (50 MP, 1/2.76in, 0.64 um, f/1.8, OIS)
budget_binned_12mp.price_tier: entry + mass-budget, up to ~INR 15k (IDC: 57% of 2025 Indian shipments are below US$200)
budget_binned_12mp.lambda_shot_scaling: linear in ISO; clip to Brooks upper bound 1.2e-2

denoise.note: strong; smears low-contrast yarn boundaries at ISO >= 400

sharpen_usm.note: reviewer-observed heavy-handed sharpening on binned output

jpeg_native.note: assumption for OEM camera apps; CameraX default is 95 (latency mode) or 100 (quality mode)

examples: any 50 MP Tetra/Quad-Bayer phone with the 50 MP mode switched on (e.g. Galaxy A07 4G)

sensor.binning: none (remosaic of the quad-Bayer to Bayer)

budget_fullres_50mp.lambda_shot_scaling: 4x the binned value (one quarter of the pixel area); linear in ISO; clip at 1.2e-2

demosaic.note: remosaic artifacts (colour mesh) reported in full-res modes

sharpen_usm.note: reviewer-observed: less processed, less artificial sharpening than the binned output

examples: Samsung Galaxy A56 (50 MP, 1/1.56in, 1.0 um, f/1.8, PDAF, OIS; INR 31,999)
Redmi Note 15 Pro 5G (200 MP ISOCELL HPE, 1/1.4in, 0.56 um, f/1.7, OIS)
midrange_binned.price_tier: ~INR 15k-35k (IDC entry-premium US$200-400: 26% of 2025 shipments, plus the top of mass-budget)

examples: Apple iPhone 16 (48 MP Fusion, 1/1.56in, 1.0 um, f/1.6, 26 mm, sensor-shift OIS; HEIF or JPEG; 24 MP super-high-resolution default per Apple for iPhone 15+)
Samsung Galaxy S series (50 MP binned to 12.5 MP)
flagship.price_tier: > ~INR 35k (IDC: 17% of 2025 shipments are above US$400; iPhone 16 was the most-shipped single model of 2025)

demosaic.note: multi-frame merges can replace demosaicing (Wronski et al. 2019); edge-aware is the closest single-frame proxy

jpeg_native.note: iPhone default HEIF is converted to JPEG when shared; model as JPEG

macro_autoswitch.effect: ultrawide/macro camera chosen: ppi x0.4-0.6 and different PSF; assumption to test on a real iPhone Pro / Android with auto-macro

examples: the phone(s) that took our 150 photos: 4608x3456 (16 MP) and 4352x3264 outputs, uploaded June 2019, before 64 MP quad-Bayer phones shipped
legacy_16mp_2019.note: calibrate against the 50 full-resolution scenes in our set (camera_aug/originals_provenance.json) once labels arrive

low_light.note: phone body shades the window; ISO range is a back-of-envelope estimate (assumption), see RESEARCH.md 2.4

messaging_standard.note: 1280 px long side reported for WhatsApp standard quality on iPhone (9to5Mac 2024); q range is an assumption to verify

messaging_hd.note: q range is an assumption to verify

pipeline_resave_q75.note: exactly what our 129 JPEG originals show: libjpeg q75 tables, 4:2:0, baseline, JFIF, no EXIF; a quarter-resolution copy exists for 62 of them
